donors_reviewed.negative_edge: A generic bridge exception is finalized as FAILED. For a real external effect, an exception after dispatch does not by itself prove NOT_APPLIED. The F2 successor must classify such an outcome UNKNOWN unless the executor can prove no effect occurred.

candidate_successor_acceptance_contract: 1. One typed effect request binds effect_id plus the exact WP102/WP104 invocation/tool-use/delegation/child identity before dispatch.
2. Deterministic capability/permission and live-generation checks occur before any side-effecting executor call.
3. A durable or exact receipt-bearing PREPARED/DISPATCH_STARTED record exists before the external side effect can occur.
4. DENY/REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION/DEGRADE never calls the executor and cannot mint an execution_attempt_id.
5. An execution receipt echoes effect_id, request/admission/execution_attempt identity and the full call-scoped correlation tuple; digest equality is never sufficient identity.
6. An exception after possible dispatch produces ExecutionOutcome.UNKNOWN unless the executor supplies positive evidence that the effect definitely did not execute.
7. UNKNOWN, PENDING/dispatch-uncertain, and VERIFIED_APPLIED states forbid blind replay; retry requires explicit reconciliation/new request according to the typed lineage.
8. Reported executor success is not verified completion; APPLIED/NOT_APPLIED requires a separate world-verification transition.
9. Restart/recovery with an unresolved dispatched attempt preserves UNKNOWN rather than guessing success or failure.
10. Same-session overlapping calls with distinct tool_use_id/effect_id remain independent under PRE(A)->PRE(B)->POST(A)->POST(B) and adversarial cross-wiring.
11. Model/J-Space/GWT confidence or narrative cannot change an EffectGate decision or completion state.
12. The successor reuses the canonical F2 state/evidence path and must not introduce a second truth database, effect journal or generic host execution route.

cases: denied before dispatch => executor call count 0
exception provably before dispatch => NOT_EXECUTED without replay ambiguity
exception after dispatch boundary => UNKNOWN + replay forbidden
reported success without world verification => EXECUTION_RECORDED only
separate verified NOT_APPLIED => new explicit request may become eligible
same-session A/B interleaving plus swapped post receipt => rejected before lineage mutation
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.promotion_boundary: Repository-CI pass of this matrix would establish only the declared enforcement/executor component path. It would not establish a real external effect, VPS runtime, physical GRID10, whole Frankenstein 2.0, EntityOS or HCU acceptance.

counterhypothesis: A minimal executor adapter that treats every raised exception as REPORTED_FAILURE may look deterministic and pass happy-path tests while reintroducing blind-replay risk after an externally applied but unacknowledged effect.
falsifier_for_counterhypothesis: Inject an executor that marks dispatch_started, applies a simulated external mutation, then raises before returning. Acceptance requires UNKNOWN plus replay forbidden until separate verification; FAILED/NOT_APPLIED or automatic retry is a failure.
recommended_action: Do not reopen the already-passed effect-correlation component. Let the active F2-WP-105 mutation authority implement the successor enforcement boundary; use this review as donor constraints and a ready failure-timing discriminator.
